body:
The new test "should pass onFieldChange to WidgetConfigPanel for live preview" doesn't actually verify the live preview functionality. It only checks that the component renders without error. Consider testing that:
1. When a widget is selected and a field is changed via the config panel, the liveSchema is updated
2. The DashboardRenderer receives and renders the updated liveSchema
3. The draft in WidgetConfigPanel is not reset when live changes propagate

This would provide meaningful coverage of the live preview feature that this PR introduces.

The handleWidgetFieldChange function only handles layoutW and layoutH special cases, but doesn't handle layoutX and layoutY. The WidgetConfigPanel schema includes width and height sliders, but if it also includes x/y position fields in the future, those changes won't be mapped correctly to the widget.layout object. Consider adding cases for layoutX and layoutY for completeness and forward compatibility.

The eslint-disable comment disables the react-hooks/exhaustive-deps rule, but this is actually correct behavior in this specific case. The PR description explains that configVersion is used to stabilize the widget config and prevent useConfigDraft reset loops. However, consider adding a more detailed comment explaining why liveSchema is intentionally omitted from the dependency array, as this pattern is non-obvious and critical to the live preview functionality. For example: "liveSchema is intentionally omitted to prevent useConfigDraft from resetting on every live field change. We only want to recompute when the widget selection changes or after save (configVersion)."
